# htmx request errors — Edge admin (shingo-edge/www/static and templates, tests and .min.js left out)

htmx.min.js version: 2.0.4
htmx default responseHandling (no page overrides it): [{code:"204",swap:false},{code:"[23]..",swap:true},{code:"[45]..",swap:false,error:true}]
htmx logs an error event's error with console.error: yes
htmx.config written by: nothing
<meta name="htmx-config"> in: no template
hx-on attributes in: nothing

## who listens for an htmx error event
htmx:responseError: nobody
htmx:sendError: nobody
htmx:sseError: nobody
htmx:timeout: nobody
htmx:swapError: nobody
htmx:targetError: nobody
htmx:onLoadError: nobody

## every htmx: listener on Edge admin
shingo-edge/www/static/js/pages/changeover.js: htmx:confirm
shingo-edge/www/static/js/pages/changeover.js: htmx:beforeSwap
shingo-edge/www/static/js/pages/changeover.js: htmx:afterSwap
shingo-edge/www/static/js/pages/changeover.js: htmx:afterSettle
shingo-edge/www/static/js/pages/orders.js: htmx:afterSwap
shared/clock.js: htmx:afterSwap
shared/clock.js: htmx:afterSwap

## so, on a partial refresh (hx-get) that answers 4xx/5xx, or never answers
4xx/5xx: htmx does not swap (responseHandling [45].. swap:false error:true) and fires htmx:responseError; nothing on the page listens, so the panel keeps its old content and the operator is shown nothing.
no answer: htmx fires htmx:sendError (and htmx:afterRequest); nothing on the page listens, so the same.
